provenance.extraction: io_banks filtered to BT_HIGH_PERFORMANCE; bank IDs numerically sorted; pin identity fields copied without reinterpretation

amd_package_pinout.join: Exact package_pin key; all 1976 RapidWright HP pins matched the official package file with equal bank number and HP I/O type.
amd_package_pinout.pairing: Official Pin Name IO_L<n>P/IO_L<n>N prefix, grouped by bank and L<n>; P/N mapped to lowercase p/n. No pairing inferred from package or site ordering.

known_conditions: unique package_pin and site across HP inventory
AMD official package Pin Name and HP bank match for every entry
complete bank-local L1 through L24 P/N pairs
four single-ended-only pins per bank have no differential pair ID
screening.scope: Package-pin/site/bank identity and differential pair identity are verified. Board-level reservations, power, connectors, cable wiring, signal integrity and hardware implementation are not certified by this inventory. Null is unknown, not false.
screening.virtual_board_policy: Selecting 36 banks, reserving the other two, selecting 20 differential data pairs per selected bank, a common 1.8 V HP-bank supply and cable pairings are explicit virtual-board decisions. They are not discovered facts about a PPro board.
screening.source_export_limitation: RapidWright supplies package-pin/site/BEL and bank identity; AMD official package data supplies pin function, pair identity and polarity. The RapidWright source exporter retains only package pins with a non-null Site and BEL.
screening.clock_rule: clock_capable identifies the official GC global-clock marker. DBC/QBC byte-clock functions remain visible in pin_function; clock_capable=false does not deny those separate clock functions. GC pins are valid user-I/O candidates and retained; a default selecting 20 non-GC pairs can reserve all four GC pairs.
screening.physical_backend_boundary: Pin identity existence is distinct from placement architecture support and routing/IO timing qualification.
screening.selection_policy: eligible_data means a complete official user-I/O differential P/N pair candidate. All 24 pairs per HP bank are retained, including four GC pairs; the four single-ended-only pins are ineligible. Eligibility assumes unused multifunction features and does not constitute board or electrical certification.
screening.multifunction_policy: DBC/QBC/AD and other multifunction features must be unused when pins carry LVDS data. Bank 65 includes configuration multifunction pins; use as data requires an explicit configuration-mode/reuse assumption or reserving this bank in the virtual board.

lvds_electrical_assumption.reference_document: UG571 v1.16, January 14 2025, LVDS and LVDS_25, page 121
lvds_electrical_assumption.scope: Supported device I/O standard and required supply/termination combination; no board power or signal-integrity validation is implied.
